name: Marwes UI AI resources
description: Deterministic package documentation and machine-readable trust artifacts for Marwes UI.
instructions: Import and use real Marwes components from @marwes-ui/react, @marwes-ui/vue, or @marwes-ui/svelte for the selected framework.
Do not invent mw-* replacement components or custom elements. Use the public exports documented by the matching Marwes adapter.
Treat the complete component registry and the canonical semantic subset as different scopes; only the named canonical families share the cross-family semantic protocol.

registry.note: 31 component families are documented in the complete registry. 9 of those families currently belong to the canonical cross-family semantic protocol.
